atoms.b: Hi, I am Ms Fitz. I am a scientist and an expert on beach wildlife. Let’s talk!
Beaches are special. Crabs, seagulls and fish all live at the beach. Many beaches have shells. Some shells are even home to crabs! There are also many types of plants at the beach.
Hey there, I’m Joe! Do you want to hear about my favourite things to do at the beach?
I like to build sandcastles and have picnics, but you can also read and sunbathe. Today I want to fish. Then I am going to have an ice cream and swim. It will be a great day!

instruction.text: Compare and contrast the texts about the beach and select all the correct answers.

hint.text: You may have to read the texts more than once to find the answers and there may be more than one correct answer.

atoms.a: What is the topic of both texts?
Who talks about activities you can do at the beach?
According to Joe, what are three activities you can do at the beach?
Who talks about plants and animals at the beach?
Which animal is mentioned by both Ms Fitz and Joe?
